title: Recovered craft not made by humanity, confirmed by AARO and the IG

tellings.quote: I am sure there are crafts that were not made by humanity at this current time and place when we recovered them.

plain: Dylan Borland, a former Air Force intelligence specialist, says he is sure the United States has recovered craft that were not made by humans of our time and place. He ties this to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has made claims about crashed-craft recovery, and to the Pentagon's office for investigating unexplained flying objects and to the Inspector General, an internal government watchdog, saying these confirmed it. If true, it would mean the government holds non-human technology.
